d: Другие части с дяденькой в профиле. Mobile Legends: Bang Bang (сокр. MLBB) — многопользовательская командная видеоигра в жанре MOBA, разработанная Moonton для мобильных устройств. Две команды, состоящие (каждая) из 5 игроков, сражаются друг с другом, чтобы достичь и уничтожить замок («базу», «трон») противника, одновременно защищая свой для контроля пути — трёх «линий» («верхняя» — топ, «центральная» — мид и «нижняя» — бот), соединяющих замки. В игре также есть карта с изображением таймингов — «баффов» и полоской здоровья на иконке героев. Каждый игрок управляет своим персонажем («героем»). Более слабые, управляемые компьютером персонажи, называемые «миньоны», появляются на замках команд и следуют по трём линиям до замка противоположной команды, сражаясь с врагами и башнями. Также присутствует система боевых заклинаний. Главной задачей является полное уничтожение центрального замка противников. #mobilelegends #Mlbb10th #ALLINMLBB #mlbb #mlbbtiktok

d: Embers of the Uncrowned is a newly announced dark-fantasy MMORPG from Nexon that leans heavily into Diablo-style isometric combat, combining fast, skill-based action with brutal, gore-filled visuals. Set on a war-torn continent devastated by a massive elven invasion, the game puts you in the role of the last heir to a fallen noble house, fighting to reclaim your land and restore your legacy. (Gematsu) Combat is designed to be both fast and tactical, with multiple distinct classes like the Spectral Blade, Executioner, and Stormbringer, each offering unique abilities and playstyles. You’ll also recruit companions and team up with other players to take on massive bosses, raids, and large-scale PvE threats that require coordination and strategy. (Gematsu) Beyond combat, the game features settlement building and progression systems, letting you grow your domain from a small camp into a thriving city as you liberate regions and expand your influence. With deep customization, co-op gameplay, and a grim narrative, Embers of the Uncrowned aims to deliver a brutal, modern take on the MMORPG formula. You wake up in HOME, a habitat drifting somewhere in space, and the only other person there is a girl called Laica who has been living in it entirely alone. So you do ordinary things. Share meals. Put music on. Go on small adventures around the station. Float together in zero gravity because there is nothing stopping you. Then you go outside. The world beyond HOME is dark and there are grotesque things moving in it, and the game turns into first-person survival horror for as long as you are out there. You come back, and it is another ordinary day with Laica. That rhythm is the whole design, and the reason it works is that something is quietly eating away at space itself, so the calm half has a clock running under it. d: where are my Filipino cozy gamers at? 🥺 there aren’t many cozy games with Filipino representation out there, but here are a few that have sprinkled a bit of our culture into their games, including some that are made in the Philippines 🇵🇭 for those who didn’t know, I’m originally from Cebu, Philippines. I moved to the Netherlands in 2017 to study and then stayed for love hihi 🥰 I feel so represented knowing that there are cozy games out there giving us even a wee bit of the spotlight 🥺 from Moonstone Island’s botanist, Ofelia, to ensaymadas in Madame Fifi’s bakery, this makes me proud to be Filipino 💕 ALSO do not mind my face 😂 it’s not my usual content but as a Filipino, we don’t take things too seriously 🤡 ALSOOOO did you know that this song is remixed by a Filipino internet cafe manager turned DJ? This genre is called Budots, and this song SLAPS.  #filipino #cozygames #cozygaming #cozygamer #cozygamingcommunity #philippines #filipinogamer #gaming #gamer #cozygame #filipinagirl

d: 🕯️ 10 เรื่องลึกของ “ถ้ำเสรีไทย ภูพาน” ถ้ำที่ไม่ได้ซ่อนแค่ความมืด… แต่เคยซ่อนชะตาของประเทศ ━ 1️⃣ ที่นี่ไม่ใช่ถ้ำธรรมดา ถ้ำเสรีไทยคือร่องรอยของขบวนการใต้ดินช่วงสงครามโลกครั้งที่ 2 พื้นที่ภูพานเคยถูกใช้เป็นฉากหลังของการเคลื่อนไหวลับ ที่ต้องอาศัยทั้งป่า ภูเขา และความไว้ใจของคนในพื้นที่ ━ 2️⃣ ทำไมต้องเป็น “ภูพาน” เพราะภูพานไม่ใช่แค่ภูเขา แต่เป็นแนวป่าที่ซับซ้อน มีทางเดินธรรมชาติ มีจุดหลบสายตา เหมาะกับการซ่อนคน ซ่อนของ และเคลื่อนกำลังโดยไม่ให้ถูกจับตา ━ 3️⃣ ถ้ำนี้เคยเกี่ยวกับอาวุธและเสบียง เรื่องเล่าทางประวัติศาสตร์ระบุว่า ถ้ำเสรีไทยเคยเป็นจุดสะสมอาวุธยุทธภัณฑ์และเสบียง ไม่ใช่เพื่อสร้างสงคราม แต่เพื่อเตรียมรับมือในวันที่ประเทศอาจไม่มีทางเลือก ━ 4️⃣ เส้นทางรอบถ้ำไม่ใช่ทางเดินเล่นธรรมดา เส้นทางธรรมชาติรอบถ้ำยาวประมาณ 5 กิโลเมตร ผ่านป่าเต็งรัง ป่าเบญจพรรณ จุดชมพระอาทิตย์ และทุ่งกระเจียว แต่มองอีกมุม นี่อาจเคยเป็น “เส้นเลือดลับ” ของการลำเลียงข่าวและเสบียง ━ 5️⃣ ชื่อ “ขุนพลภูพาน” ไม่ได้มาเพราะบังเอิญ เตียง ศิริขันธ์ คือหนึ่งในแกนสำคัญของเสรีไทยสายอีสาน เขาไม่ได้เป็นแค่คนในประวัติศาสตร์ แต่เป็นภาพแทนของเครือข่ายคนธรรมดาที่เลือกยืนอยู่ข้างเอกราช ━ 6️⃣ รหัสลับ “พลูโต” ในโลกของปฏิบัติการใต้ดิน ชื่อจริงอาจอันตรายเกินไป รหัสลับจึงไม่ใช่แค่ชื่อเรียก แต่มันคือเกราะป้องกันชีวิตของทั้งคนส่งข่าว คนรับข่าว และคนร่วมขบวน ━ 7️⃣ คนในพื้นที่คือกำลังสำคัญ เสรีไทยไม่ได้ขับเคลื่อนด้วยผู้นำเพียงคนเดียว แต่ต้องพึ่งชาวบ้าน ครู กำนัน ผู้ใหญ่บ้าน และคนธรรมดาที่รู้เส้นทางป่า เพราะในภูมิประเทศแบบนี้ คนรู้พื้นที่คือกุญแจของทุกภารกิจ ━ 8️⃣ ความลี้ลับของถ้ำ อาจเกิดจากความทรงจำ บางคนเล่าถึงบรรยากาศเหมือนมีคนเดิน แสงตะเกียงลึกในป่า หรือความรู้สึกเหมือนพื้นที่นี้ยังไม่เคยว่างเปล่า บางทีสิ่งที่เรากลัว… อาจไม่ใช่ผี แต่อาจเป็น “เสียงสะท้อนของประวัติศาสตร์” ━ 9️⃣ ถ้ำที่เงียบที่สุด อาจเคยดังที่สุด ในวันที่สงครามยังไม่จบ ทุกเสียงกิ่งไม้หัก ทุกแสงไฟ และทุกฝีเท้า อาจหมายถึงชีวิตของคนทั้งเครือข่าย ━ 🔟 วันนี้ถ้ำเสรีไทยคือบทเรียน มันเตือนเราว่า เอกราชไม่ได้เกิดจากคำประกาศสวยงาม แต่เกิดจากคนจำนวนมากที่ทำงานในเงามืด โดยหวังเพียงให้ประเทศยังเป็นของคนไทย ━ ทุกตำนาน… มักมีความจริงซ่อนอยู่เสมอ #โคตรลี้ลับ #บันทึกลับ #ความลึกลับ #ประวัติศาสตร์ลับ #ปริศนาโลก #ถ้ำเสรีไทย #ภูพาน #สกลนคร #เสรีไทย #ขุนพลภูพาน #ประวัติศาสตร์ไทย #สงครามโลกครั้งที่2

zh: 自由泰洞(Phu Phan)的10个深度故事：这个洞穴藏匿的不仅是黑暗...曾藏着一个国家的命运 ━ 1️⃣ 这不是普通洞穴，自由泰洞是二战时期地下运动的痕迹，Phu Phan地区曾被用作秘密活动的背景，依赖森林、山脉和当地人的信任 ━ 2️⃣ 为什么是"Phu Phan"？因为Phu Phan不仅是山，更是复杂林带，有天然小径和隐蔽点，适合藏人、藏物和秘密调动力量 ━ 3️⃣ 此洞曾与武器和补给有关，历史记载称自由泰洞曾是武器弹药和补给储备点，不是为了挑起战争，而是为国家走投无路之日做准备 ━ 4️⃣ 洞周路径非普通步道，环绕洞穴的天然小径长约5公里，穿越龙脑香林、混交林、观日点和Curcuma花田，但换个角度看，这可能是当时运送情报和补给的"秘密血管" ━ 5️⃣ "Phu Phan将军"之名非偶然，Tiang Sirikhanth是东北部自由泰运动的核心人物之一，他不仅是历史人物，更象征那些选择站在独立一边的普通人网络 ━ 6️⃣ 地下行动世界中的"Pluto"代号，真名可能过于危险，代号不仅是称呼，更是保护送信人、收信人和组织成员生命的盾牌 ━ 7️⃣ 当地人是关键力量，自由泰不止靠单一领袖驱动，还需依靠村民、教师、村长、乡绅和熟悉林径的普通人，在这种地形下，熟知地域的人是每项任务的关键 ━ 8️⃣ 洞穴的神秘感可能源于记忆，有人讲述那种氛围：仿佛有人行走、深林中灯笼的光影，或感觉此地从未真正空寂过，也许我们害怕的…不是鬼，而是"历史的回声" ━ 9️⃣ 最寂静的洞穴，或许曾最喧闹，在战争未息之日，每根树枝断裂声、每道光亮、每个脚步声，都可能意味着整个网络人员的生死 ━ 🔟 今日，自由泰洞是一堂课，它提醒我们：独立非出自漂亮的宣言，而是由无数在暗影中工作的人铸就，只盼望国家仍属于泰国人民 ━ 每个传说…总隐藏着真实

d: [MULTO - A Short Film] It’s been months since I first heard this song. I don’t remember the exact day, but I remember the weight it left behind. I’d be in my room, doing nothing, and suddenly it would echo in my head—pulling me back into something I thought I had moved on from. This song became a ghost. Not just of someone, but of how it all felt: warm, fleeting, familiar. The kind of feeling you try to outgrow but never really do. In the end, I will remain haunting myself. I am my own ghost. d: "Mangkukulam" In Philippine folklore, a mangkukulam is a person, often depicted as a witch, who practices kulam, a form of black magic or witchcraft, and can cast spells or curses on others. They are known for using rituals, potions, and even voodoo dolls to inflict harm, illness, or misfortune on their victims. While often associated with negative actions, some mangkukulam are also believed to use their powers for healing or herbal magic, similar to an albularyo (witch doctor). #Mangkukulam #Philippines #Horror #Monster #Trending #Viral #AI #Veo3 #FYP

d: This movie had no business being this scary 😱😭 Make sure to follow the legendary @thetyhodges 🔥🔥 Don't Look Under the Bed (1997) was one of Disney Channel’s creepiest original movies, blending childhood imagination, supernatural mysteries, and genuinely unsettling horror into an unforgettable Halloween classic. Following Frances McCausland as she encounters a mysterious imaginary friend and a terrifying boogeyman, the movie delivered scares that felt closer to a real horror film than a typical kids’ movie. Its creepy atmosphere, eerie makeup, and nightmare-inducing scenes sparked controversy, with some parents questioning whether it was simply too scary for children. Disney eventually pulled it from regular Halloween rotations, only adding to its legendary status among millennials who grew up watching it!

Eun A, once a hotelier and now a guesthouse manager, pursues independence with determination, setting small goals for herself despite life’s setbacks. d: Russian artist Maria Luneva, known as Supinatra, creates surreal works using flowers, plants, insects and the human body. Instead of treating nature as decoration, she studies the shape, color and texture of each natural object and imagines what else it could become. A flower can resemble part of a face, petals can become eyelashes, and plants can transform into strange pieces of jewelry or clothing.  Her practice brings together performance, photography, sculpture and fashion, often using her own body as the surface where these transformations happen. #art #avantgarde #artist #flower #weird
zh: 俄罗斯艺术家 Maria Luneva，人称 Supinatra，利用花卉、植物、昆虫与人体创作超现实作品。她不将自然当作装饰，而是研究每个自然物的形状、颜色和纹理，想象它还能变成什么。花可以像人脸的一部分，花瓣可以成为睫毛，植物能转化为奇特的珠宝或服装。她的创作融合表演、摄影、雕塑和时尚，常常用自己的身体作为这些变形的载体。

d: artist RJ creates digital paintings and looping animations exploring everyday life and our increasingly complicated relationship with technology.  His deliberately simple visual language is part of the work. RJ primarily paints using minimal browser-based programs, then uses compression and animation to create images that feel flattened, fragmented and unmistakably connected to the aesthetics of the internet.  His characters inhabit strangely familiar situations: scrolling through phones, sitting alone, socializing, travelling or simply passing time. Ordinary moments become short, endlessly repeating digital scenes. #art #avantgarde #artist #weird #niche
zh: 艺术家 RJ 创作数字绘画和循环动画，探索日常生活以及我们与科技日益复杂的关系。他刻意简化的视觉语言是作品的一部分。RJ 主要使用极简的浏览器程序作画，然后利用压缩和动画技术，创造出扁平、碎片化且明显与互联网美学相连的图像。他笔下的人物活在奇异又熟悉的情境中：刷手机、独自坐着、社交、旅行或只是消磨时间。这些普通的瞬间变成了一幕幕无休止重复的简短数字场景。

zh: 《这就是娱乐圈，宝贝！》今天满一周年了 我的首张专辑筹备了多年，所以她现在已问世整整一年这感觉太不真实了（同时感觉又像昨天一样？？？）我的每一个侧面都在这部作品里找到了归宿——闯荡音乐圈的起起伏伏、我的感情关系，以及一路走来面对的所有心魔。它由养育我的音乐和各方影响塑造成型，全部包装在毫无歉意的流行少女气息之中。我想大声感谢你们每一个人对我的音乐的支持。永远感激每一位为我挺身而出的人 感谢我所有的制作人和词曲作者朋友帮我找到自己的声音。通过这张唱片，我对自己有了太多了解，好的坏的都有。有点好笑的是，我写下的那些事，自己却又被卷了回去，不得不重新面对——这一次全靠我自己了。这是一个触发创伤又治愈疗伤的过程，我会永远把这张首专视为我找到自我的专辑。真他妈是一趟神奇的狂野旅程，每一步都让我目瞪口呆、惊掉下巴✨✨✨ 生日快乐，《这就是娱乐圈，宝贝！》！

d: POV: The baby is delivered… but still inside a clear, fluid-filled bubble. 👶✨ That’s not a complication. That’s a rare and beautiful moment. This is called an en caul birth 🌊 The newborn emerges completely enclosed within the intact amniotic sac — like a tiny water balloon cradling new life. What happens next? 👇 🩺 The medical team carefully opens the membrane 💧 Amniotic fluid drains 🫁 Air reaches the lungs 👶 First breath. First cry. It looks dramatic — but it’s a natural obstetric variation. High-yield facts 📚 • Extremely rare (more common in preterm births) • Usually seen in cesarean deliveries • The sac protects the baby during birth • Requires swift but gentle membrane rupture after delivery Exam pearl 💡 En caul ≠ complication. It’s simply delivery with intact membranes. zh: 视角：宝宝娩出……但仍包裹在一个透明的、充满液体的水囊中。这不是并发症，这是一个罕见而美丽的时刻。这被称为胎膜完整分娩。新生儿完全被包裹在完整的羊膜囊内，就像一个托举着新生命的微小水气球。接下来会发生什么？医疗团队小心地打开胎膜，羊水流出，空气进入肺部。第一次呼吸，第一声啼哭。看上去很戏剧化，但这是自然的产科变异。高分知识点：极其罕见（早产更常见）；多见于剖宫产；囊膜在分娩中保护宝宝；出生后需迅速而轻柔地破膜。考试要点：胎膜完整分娩不等于并发症，只是胎膜完整的娩出而已。对许多医生来说，这是职业生涯难得一遇的超现实时刻。如果你喜欢罕见的产科瞬间，收藏这条；用出生科学吸引朋友，标记他们。

d: If you think we’re living the good life, you should know how happy and free our dog is! ❤️🐶🌴 In the Philippines, we have our own amazing dogs. They’re called Asong Pinoy (Aspin) and sometimes people refer to the more native, jungle-adapted types as Asong Gubat. They may not have fancy papers or high price tags, but they are some of the smartest, most loyal, and most resilient dogs you can have. These dogs have grown up adapting to the tropical heat, island life, and local environment for generations. That means they are naturally hardy, generally healthier, and often require less maintenance compared to many imported breeds that struggle with the climate. They’re incredibly intuitive, protective of their families, and surprisingly easy to train. Choosing to adopt an Aspin doesn’t mean there’s anything wrong with buying a purebred dog. But in a country where so many beautiful local dogs are still waiting for homes, adopting one can truly change a life.  Unfortunately, many island dogs are left abandoned and even thrown away as puppies. 💔 It’s another reality that we never see online but live with as you see them or visit the island. If you’d like to help there are a few vets and organizations doing their best to make a difference in the improvement of lives of animals here in Siargao. If you can, share your love with them!! @puppypuddlesiargao is doing amazing things by amazing women.  If you know of any other groups, please drop them in the comments!  And if you’d like to adopt dogs and puppies, there are always some As Pin (Asong Pinoy) dogs and puppies that are looking for loving and safe homes. ❤️🫶🏾🙏🏾
zh: 如果你觉得我们过得很好，那你该看看我们的狗有多快乐多自由！在菲律宾，我们有自己出色的狗，叫本地犬，有时更原生、适应丛林的类型被称为丛林犬。它们或许没有血统证书或高昂身价，但却是最聪明、最忠诚、最坚韧的狗。这些狗世代适应热带高温、海岛生活与本土环境，天生强壮，通常更健康，比许多不适应气候的进口品种更好养。它们直觉敏锐、守护家人，而且意外地好训练。选择领养一只本土犬，并不意味着买纯种狗就是错的。但在这个有无数美丽本地狗仍在等待家庭的国家，领养一只真的可以改变一条生命。不幸的是，许多岛上狗狗被遗弃，甚至幼犬就被扔掉。这是在线上看不到、但在岛上生活或到访时能见到的另一现实。如果你想帮忙，锡亚高有一些兽医和组织正努力改善动物的生活。如果你有能力，请把爱分享给他们！@puppypuddlesiargao 的出色女性们正在做着了不起的事。如果你知道其他团体，请在评论区留言！如果你想领养狗狗，总有一些本土犬正在寻找充满爱和安全的家。

zh: 巴厘岛舞蹈中的Sledet是一种快速而锐利的眼神动作，通常用于描绘强烈的情感，如惊讶、悲伤或喜悦。

d: Video latihan tari di Sanggar Pradnya Swari, Jembrana, Bali, viral di media sosial. Anak-anak yang berlatih—baik laki-laki maupun perempuan—tampak serius menguasai nyeledet, gerak mata khas dalam tari Bali. Nyeledet bukan sekadar melirik, tetapi gerakan cepat dan tajam yang harus selaras dengan ekspresi wajah, posisi kepala, dan irama gamelan. Teknik ini dikenal sulit karena membutuhkan konsentrasi tinggi serta kontrol otot mata yang kuat. Merujuk kajian seniman dan akademisi tari Bali, I Wayan Dibia, nyeledet menjadi elemen penting dalam membangun karakter tarian seperti Legong dan Kebyar, sekaligus menunjukkan kedalaman ekspresi penari. Dalam video yang beredar, anak-anak tampak berulang kali mengulang gerakan demi mencapai ketepatan. Latihan intens itu menggambarkan proses panjang di balik keindahan tari Bali yang selama ini terlihat memukau di atas panggung. #BALI #videoviral #tari
zh: 巴厘岛Jembrana的Pradnya Swari舞蹈工作室的训练视频在社交媒体上走红。练舞的孩子们——无论男孩女孩——都认真地掌握nyeledet，即巴厘舞蹈中标志性的眼神动作。Nyeledet不仅仅是瞥一眼，而是一种必须与面部表情、头部位置和甘美兰节奏相协调的快速锐利动作。这项技巧以高难度著称，需要高度集中的注意力和强大的眼部肌肉控制。根据巴厘岛舞蹈艺术家和学者I Wayan Dibia的研究，nyeledet是构建Legong和Kebyar等舞蹈角色的重要元素，同时也展现了舞者的表现深度。在流传的视频中，孩子们为了达到精准度反复练习动作。这种高强度训练描绘了巴厘岛舞蹈在舞台上令人惊艳的美丽背后漫长的过程。

d: The Traditional Dance of Bali: Legong Explained Legong is one of Bali’s most iconic and sacred traditional dances, known for its intricate eye movements, graceful hand gestures, and deep cultural meaning. Unlike modern dance trends, Legong requires years of training, often starting as early as five years old. Originally performed by young girls in royal courts, the dance symbolizes purity, discipline, and spiritual devotion—often as an offering to the gods during temple ceremonies. Today, men are also learning Legong, helping to preserve and evolve this art form for future generations. Every movement in Legong tells a story, usually drawn from ancient Hindu epics, making it more than just a dance—it’s a living expression of Balinese identity and heritage.  #bali #culture #traditionaldance #traditional #culturalheritage #dance #folkdance #culturaldiversitycostume #shorts #interestingshorts #uniqueshorts

zh: 巴厘岛传统舞蹈：Legong解析 Legong是巴厘岛最具标志性和神圣性的传统舞蹈之一，以复杂的眼神动作、优美的手势和深厚的文化内涵而闻名。与现代舞蹈潮流不同，Legong需要多年的训练，通常从五岁就开始了。最初由王室宫廷中的年轻女孩表演，这种舞蹈象征着纯洁、纪律和精神奉献——常作为寺庙仪式中对神灵的供奉。如今，男性也在学习Legong，帮助为后代保护和传承这种艺术形式。Legong中的每一个动作都在讲述一个故事，通常取材自古印度史诗，使其不仅仅是舞蹈——更是巴厘岛身份与遗产的鲜活表达。

d: Yung Lean’s STORM is more than a music video—it’s a carefully choreographed visual experience. Directed by Romain Gavras with choreography by Damien Jalet, the performance combines cinematic storytelling, synchronized movement, and striking production to create something that feels closer to a short film than a traditional music video. Every detail, from the choreography to the camera work, was designed to serve the music. It’s a reminder that when artists and filmmakers fully commit to a creative vision, music videos can still become unforgettable pieces of art. #YungLean #Storm #MusicVideo #Choreography #MusicMoments
zh: Yung Lean的STORM不仅仅是一支音乐视频，更是一场精心编排的视觉体验。由Romain Gavras执导，Damien Jalet编舞，这场表演结合了电影化的叙事、同步的动作和引人注目的制作，呈现出更接近短片而非传统音乐视频的感觉。从编舞到摄影，每个细节都旨在服务于音乐。这提醒我们，当艺术家和电影人全身心投入创作愿景时，音乐视频依然可以成为令人难忘的艺术品。

Hot Honey Chicken Pasta 🍯🔥 the viral recipe with over 60+ million views, 20/10 hits every time! Recipe: Chicken Tenders • 1 lb chicken tenderloins • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, adjust to spice) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 sazon packet • 1–2 cups buttermilk • ⅛ cup jalapeño or pickle juice • 3 cups all-purpose flour (season with same seasonings) Hot Honey Sauce • ½ cup buffalo sauce • ¼ cup honey • ⅛ cup hot sauce (optional) Pasta • 1 lb penne pasta • 2 tbsp unsalted butter • 2 garlic cloves, finely minced • ½ yellow onion, finely chopped • 1 ½ cups heavy cream • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 tsp black pepper • Grated mozzarella • Grated Parmesan Instructions 1. Season chicken tenderloins add in buttermilk and jalapeño/pickle juice then marinate for at least 30 minutes to an hour.  2. Coat chicken in seasoned flour set aside on wire rack and rest for 10 minutes before frying. Fry at 350°F until golden brown and crispy. Set aside and let cool on a wire rack. 3. In a sauce pan, add 1 tbsp of unsalted butter, buffalo sauce, honey, and hot sauce and simmer until fully combined. Then toss chicken in the hot honey sauce. 4. In a skillet, melt butter and sauté garlic and onion until fragrant. Pour in heavy cream and stir in all seasonings. 5. d: Nasi Goreng Indonesia - Indonesian Fried Rice #friedrice #easyrecipes #recipe  Ingredients 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 egg 3 cups cooked rice 4 slices fish cake, thinly sliced 4 large prawns, peeled and deveined A handful of fresh squid, cleaned and sliced 1 tbsp light soy sauce 2 tbsp kecap manis (sweet soy sauce) 1 tsp dark caramel sauce 1 tbsp sambal (adjust to taste) Large pinch of YumYum or MSG 1 bird’s eye chili, finely sliced 1 spring onion, thinly sliced 2 tbsp fried garlic Sliced cucumber and tomato, to serve Fried egg, to serve INSTRUCTIONS 1. Heat a wok over high heat and add a splash of oil. Add the minced garlic and stir-fry until fragrant. 2. Crack in the egg and scramble it quickly, breaking it into small pieces as it cooks. 3. Add the cooked rice to the wok and toss thoroughly, breaking up any clumps and ensuring it’s well-coated in the egg and garlic mixture. 4. Add the fish cake, prawns, and squid. Toss everything together and stir-fry until the seafood is cooked through. 5. Mix in the light soy sauce, kecap manis, dark caramel sauce, and sambal. Stir well to evenly coat the rice and proteins with the sauce. 6. Toss in the bird’s eye chili and sliced spring onion. Stir-fry briefly to combine. 7. Sprinkle the fried garlic over the rice and give it one final toss. 8. Serve hot, garnished with sliced cucumber and tomato, and top with a fried egg.
zh: 印尼炒饭 食材 蒜 3 瓣，切末 鸡蛋 1 个 米饭 3 碗 鱼饼 4 片，切薄片 大虾 4 只，去壳去虾线 鲜鱿鱼一小把，洗净切圈 生抽 1 汤匙 甜酱油 2 汤匙 老抽 1 茶匙 参巴酱 1 汤匙（可调整） 味精 一大撮 小米辣 1 个，切细圈 青葱 1 根，切薄片 炸蒜 2 汤匙 黄瓜片、番茄片 适量，摆盘用 煎蛋 1 个，摆盘用 做法 1. 烧热炒锅，大火，下少许油。放蒜末炒香。 2. 打入鸡蛋，快速炒散，碎成小块。 3. 下米饭，彻底翻炒，打散结块，让米粒均匀裹上蛋液和蒜。 4. 下鱼饼、虾和鱿鱼。翻炒到海鲜熟透。 5. 加入生抽、甜酱油、老抽和参巴酱。炒匀，给米饭和配料均匀上色。 6. 撒入小米辣和青葱。略炒几下即可。 7. 撒上炸蒜，最后翻拌均匀。 8. 热腾腾出锅，用黄瓜片和番茄片点缀，盖上一个煎蛋。

zh: 丹东洛克牛肉。每次参加完国庆比赛我就特别容易饿。关键是印尼菜那种辣、咸香、浓郁醇厚的味道。🔽食谱🔽 腌料：1公斤牛肉、10瓣红葱头（磨碎）、10瓣蒜（磨碎）、1汤匙罗望子酱、3片月桂叶、4根香茅、1拇指大小的生姜、8片青柠叶、1汤匙芫荽粉、半汤匙盐、1汤匙味精、1汤匙牛肉味高汤粉、1.1升嫩椰水。 研磨香料：12个大的红辣椒、20个红卷辣椒、5个红小米椒、18瓣红葱头、4瓣蒜。 炒制香料：SunCo食用油、研磨香料、8片青柠叶、1茶匙牛肉味高汤粉、1茶匙味精、半茶匙盐、1汤匙罗望子汁。你们国庆节都干啥了？我呢，还是在家做印尼菜，当然用的油是SunCo，香气和美味附着在食物上，好吃的是菜不是油。更何况SunCo是100%印尼原产的产品。

d: Mom’s Indonesian Beef Rendang 🇲🇨   What I grew up eating for over 17 years back in my hometown, Indonesia🇲🇨😍. Today, I share this recipe with you, in honor of Indonesia's Independence Day. Happy Independence Day Indonesia, Indonesia MERDEKA! 🇮🇩✨ Ingredients A: 1.4kg of beef, topside or silverside, diced into 4cm chunks 800ml of regular coconut cream 400ml of coconut milk 1 tbsp of chicken powder 1 tbsp of Sugar 2 tsp of salt 2 tbsp of coconut sugar 6 tbsp of vegetable oil for stir fry  Ingredients B, to blend: 15 cloves of garlic  3 medium onions or 250g, chopped 30g of ginger,, cut into small pieces  30g of turmeric, cut into small pieces 6 candlenuts 30g of galangal, cut into small pieces 4 stalks lemongrass, chopped 6 tbsp of vegetable oil, to blend Ingredients C: 5 bay leaves 8 kaffir lime leaves 4 lemongrass, chopped 8 cloves wholes 3 cinnamon sticks 4 cardamoms 4 star anises Seasoning: 2 tsp of cilantro ground 2 tsp of turmeric ground 2 tsp of white pepper 2 tsp of cinnamon powder Steps: 1. Cut the beef into 4cm chunks and do not cut the beef into smaller pieces as they will break down during the cooking. 2. Add all of the Ingredients B in a blender or food processor. Then, blend it or give it a blitz until all the become a thick paste. Set aside 3. In the heavily-bottomed pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat. 4. Then, pour the paste (from Ingredients B) into the pan and cook the paste until fragrant for 2 minutes. 5. Add the “Ingredients C” to the pan and stir to mix. 6. Next, add the “Seasoning” and followed by chicken powder, sugar and salt to the pan. Cook the paste until fragrant ( the paste will change color to red-brown ish ) 7. Add the beef to the pan and cook the beef until it is lightly browned.  8. Add coconut milk into the pan and stir to combine. Then, add coconut cream and bring it to simmer. 9. Cover and simmer in low heat for 1 hour until the beef is tender and the sauce thickens. (Stir it periodically to prevent the meat from burning) 10. Once the sauce has thickened and released reddish oil, add coconut sugar and give it a final mix. 11. Cover and simmer for another 30 minutes until it turns into dark brown. 12. Once it is done, enjoy with a bowl of rice! Notes: You should let the meat sit overnight for the flavors to be fully absorbed in the meat #indonesianfood #beefrendang #dinnerideas #easyrecipes
zh: 妈妈的印尼牛肉仁当。这是我在家乡印尼吃了超过17年的味道。今天，为庆祝印尼独立日，我把这个食谱分享给你们。印尼独立日快乐，自由印度尼西亚！ 材料A：1.4公斤牛肉（臀肉或腿肉，切成4厘米块状）、800毫升浓缩椰浆、400毫升椰奶、1汤匙鸡精粉、1汤匙白糖、2茶匙盐、2汤匙椰糖、6汤匙植物油（用于翻炒）。 材料B（搅打用）：15瓣蒜、3个中等洋葱（约250克，切碎）、30克生姜（切小块）、30克黄姜（切小块）、6颗石栗、30克南姜（切小块）、4根香茅（切碎）、6汤匙植物油（用于搅打）。 材料C：5片月桂叶、8片青柠叶、4根香茅（切段）、8颗丁香、3根肉桂棒、4颗豆蔻、4颗八角。 调味料：2茶匙芫荽粉、2茶匙黄姜粉、2茶匙白胡椒粉、2茶匙肉桂粉。 步骤：1. 将牛肉切成4厘米块状，不要切太小，炖煮时会散。2. 将所有材料B放入搅拌机，打成浓稠酱状。备用。3. 厚底锅中用中高火烧热植物油。4. 倒入酱料（材料B），炒香约2分钟。5. 加入"材料C"拌匀。6. 加入"调味料"、鸡精粉、糖和盐，炒至酱料出香（颜色会变成红褐色）。7. 加入牛肉，稍微煎至变色。8. 倒入椰奶拌匀，再加入浓缩椰浆，煮至微沸。9. 加盖，用小火炖1小时，直至牛肉软烂、酱汁浓稠（期间不时搅拌以防粘锅）。10. 待酱汁收浓并析出红油，加入椰糖拌匀。11. 加盖再炖30分钟至颜色变成深褐色。12. 做好后，配上一碗米饭享用！ 备注：煮好后最好放置一晚，让肉更入味。

d: Ini kali kedua saya masak rendang dalam hidup saya. Yang pertama waktu tinggal di Lombok menggunakan ayam dan yang kedua vegetarian menggunakan kacang merah dan kentang. Dan keduanya di request oleh orang yang sama. Di Lombok paling mudah karena semua bahan tersedia, tantangan di US tidak mudah mendapatkan semua bahan yang di butuhkan terutama kelapa parut. Untuk seluruh bahan ini saya peroleh dari setiap toko Asia dari hampir 7 negara bagian yang saya pernah kunjungi di US sejak tinggal di sini. Akhirnya seluruh bumbu masakan Indonesua lengkap dan saya semakin pede karena tutorial nya langsung dari adik ku yang asli orang Padang. Dari Deni @Agustina_Sri dan pengalaman ke dua ini barulah saya mengetahui apa bedanya Kalio dan rendang. ang this is it, rendang vegetarian tanpa kelapa gongseng made in by me from North Carolina #rendang #vegetarianfood #madeinlove #indonesianfood
zh: 这是我人生中第二次做仁当。第一次是在龙目岛生活时用了鸡肉，第二次是素食版，用了红芸豆和土豆。而且两次都是同一个人要的。在龙目岛最容易，所有食材都买得到，在美国的挑战是不容易找到所需食材，尤其是椰丝。这些食材是我住在美国以来，从几乎跑遍七个州的每一家亚洲超市收集来的。终于印尼菜的调料齐全了，我也更有信心了，因为教程直接来自我在巴东土生土长的弟弟。由 Deni @Agustina_Sri 提供。经过这第二次体验，我才知道 Kalio 和仁当的区别。好了，这就是它了，没有椰丝的素食仁当，由我在北卡罗来纳州制作。

d: Cajun butter steak bites over parmesan mashed potatoes🥩🧈 recipe below: Cajun butter🧈 -4 tbsp unsalted softened butter  -1/2 tsp seasoned Cajun -1 tsp parsley -2 tsp minced garlic  -1 tsp lemon juice -1/2 tsp Dijon mustard  Mix until combined (optional: add red pepper flakes for spice) Cajun steak bites🥩 -trim 2 steaks of choice into 1 inch pieces -season with 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce and 1 tsp buttery steakhouse seasoning -let steaks rest before cooking to avoid chewy steak bites ** -cook in avocado oil on med/high heat -flip after 1-2 minutes  -reduce heat and stir in 2 tbsp Cajun butter -toss steak bites 1 additional minute  -remove steak and add asparagus  -season asparagus with lemon juice, garlic powder, salt, pepper, & Parmesan  creamy Parmesan mashed potatoes🥔 -peel 2 large gold potatoes  -dice into 1 inch cubes  -boil in salted water -drain water and mash -stir in 1/2 cup heavy cream, 2 tbsp sour cream, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese, 1/2 tbsp butter, salt, pepper, & garlic powder  Assembly✨ -Add creamy Parmesan mashed potatoes to a bowl and top with Cajun butter steak bites🥩 Serve with asparagus, ciabatta, & garnish with parsley  #cooking #foodtiktok #fyp  #creatorsearchinsights #whatdoimakefordinner

Whenever I am super hungry I crave this easy, and so delicious beef! Quick dinner recipe! Today I’m making an easy beef stir-fry with peppers, onions and a garlic-ginger sauce that’s too good to leave in the pan. Make some rice to go with it. You’ll see why! The sauce is simple: soy sauce, fresh garlic and ginger, a splash of vinegar and just a little brown sugar. Together with the beef, sweet red pepper and onions, it makes a lovely homemade dinner for those evenings when you’re craving takeout. The poblano pepper is optional, so you can leave it out. The green onions are optional too, although I really recommend adding them at the end! Serve this pepper steak over rice or with noodles, and spoon some of the sauce over the top. There’s no need to make anything complicated on the side. I hope this gives you a new idea for dinner this week. Tell me in the comments what you would serve with it, and let me know how it turns out when you make it. I love hearing about the recipes you try. Subscribe to Essen Recipes for more simple homemade dinners with beef, chicken, potatoes and the everyday ingredients you already enjoy cooking with. Enjoy the cooking! Lots of love, Sophie

Hot rice, spicy chicken, loads of garlic and chilli, Holy basil, then a crispy fried egg on top. Simple food, but when it’s done properly it’s honestly one of my favourite things to eat. This is my version at home. And before the Pad Kra Pao police come for me, I’m joking when I say it’s exactly like Thailand 😂 I just make it the way I like eating it salty, spicy, a little bit sweet, heaps of basil and enough sauce to get all through the rice. If you’re Thai or you make Pad Kra Pao better than me, tell me what I should change. I actually want to know.

d: Voici une recette simple de frites aux bœuf et oignons caramélisés   Ingrédients 	•	Pommes de terre  	•	1 oignon 	•	1 gousse d’ail 	•	Bœuf (en petits lanières)  	•	1 c. à café de ras el hanout 	•	Sel, poivre 	•	Persil 	•	Huile  Préparation 	1.	Préparer les frites 	•	Éplucher et couper les pommes de terre en frites. 	•	Les rincer et bien les sécher. 	•	Les faire frire ou cuire au four avec un peu d’huile et du sel jusqu’à ce qu’elles soient dorées. 	2.	Caraméliser l’oignon 	•	Émincer l’oignon. 	•	Faire chauffer 1 à 2 c. à soupe d’huile dans une poêle. 	•	Cuire l’oignon à feu moyen-doux 10–15 min jusqu’à ce qu’il devienne doré et légèrement sucré. 	•	Ajouter l’ail haché et cuire 1 minute. 	3.	Cuire le bœuf 	•	Ajouter le bœuf dans la poêle. 	•	Assaisonner avec le ras el hanout, sel et poivre. 	•	Cuire 5–7 minutes en mélangeant. 	4.	Assemblage 	•	Mettre les frites dans une assiette ou un plat. 	•	Ajouter le mélange bœuf-oignon dessus. 	•	Parsemer de persil. #boeuf #recette #recettefacile #ideerecette #ramadan

d: ⇩レシピはこちらから🫶🏻 ＼甘辛だれでおかわり必須✨／ 『牛まいたけごはん』 牛肉と舞茸を甘辛く炒めて、 炊きたてご飯にどーん！🤤🤍 牛肉の旨みと舞茸の香りがご飯に絡んで、 おかわりしたくなる美味しさ🍚✨ みんなも保存して作ってみてね🙌🏻 𓂃𓈒𓏸 【材料】2〜3人分 ・米…2合 ・牛肉切り落とし…250g ・舞茸…1パック ・バター…5gくらい ・大葉、卵黄…お好みで 〈炊き込み調味料〉 ・しょうゆ…大さじ1 ・白だし…大さじ1 ・みりん…大さじ1 ・顆粒だし…小さじ1 〈甘辛だれ〉 ・しょうゆ…大さじ2 ・みりん…大さじ1 ・酒…大さじ1 ・砂糖…大さじ1 ・しょうがチューブ…3cm 𓂃𓈒𓏸 【作り方】 ① 炊飯釜に洗った米と〈炊き込み調味料〉を入れ、2合の目盛りまで水を加えて混ぜ、通常炊飯する ② フライパンに舞茸と牛肉を入れてバターで炒める ③ 火が通ったら〈甘辛だれ〉を加えて、全体に絡める ④ ご飯が炊けたら③をたれごと加えて、全体をよく混ぜる🍚 ⑤ お好みで大葉と卵黄をのせたら完成✨ 💡甘辛だれまで一緒に混ぜることで、牛肉と舞茸の旨みがご飯全体に絡んで美味しい🤤🤍 𓂃𓈒𓏸 このアカウントでは、 ✔️仕事終わりでもパパッと作りたい🍳 ✔️毎日の「今日何作ろう…」を減らしたい💭 ✔️大切な人が喜ぶごはんを作りたい🤍 そんなあなたに向けて、 ふたりで「うまっ！」って笑える簡単ごはんを発信しています🌷 「美味しそう！」「作ってみたい！」と思ったら、 いいねやコメントで教えてもらえると嬉しいです🥰 #牛肉レシピ #炊き込みご飯 #秋レシピ #簡単レシピ #同棲ごはん

zh: 食谱请看这里。甜咸酱汁，绝对想再来一碗。牛肉舞茸盖饭。将牛肉和舞茸用甜咸酱炒制，铺在刚煮好的米饭上。牛肉的鲜味和舞茸的香气包裹着米饭，好吃到想添饭。大家记得收藏并试试看。材料（2-3人份）：米2杯、牛肉片250克、舞茸1包、黄油约5克、紫苏叶和蛋黄按喜好添加。炊饭调味料：酱油1汤匙、白酱油1汤匙、味醂1汤匙、颗粒高汤粉1茶匙。甜咸酱汁：酱油2汤匙、味醂1汤匙、料酒1汤匙、糖1汤匙、生姜泥3厘米。做法：1. 在电饭煲内胆放入洗好的米和炊饭调味料，加水至2杯刻度线，正常煮饭。2. 平底锅中放入舞茸和牛肉，用黄油炒制。3. 肉熟后加入甜咸酱汁，翻炒裹匀。4. 饭煮好后，将步骤3的食材连酱汁一起倒入，充分拌匀。5. 按喜好放上紫苏叶和蛋黄即完成。连酱汁一起搅拌，牛肉和舞茸的鲜味会浸润所有米饭，更美味。此账号为想下班后快速做饭、减少每日“今天做什么”烦恼、为重要的人做开心的饭菜的你，分享两人会笑着称赞“好吃！”的简单料理。觉得看起来好吃或想试试的话，请通过点赞评论告诉我。

d: 요즘 알고리즘에 계속 뜨는 마늘삼겹찜!! 먹어보고 싶어서 제미나이한테 레시피 물어봐서 참고해서 만들었는데 이거 진짜 밥도둑이에요..🤤👍 너무 맛있어요ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ 양념소스도 잘 어울려서 맛있는데 진짜 킥은 마늘인 거 같아요 양념소스랑 너무 잘 어울리는데 저 씹히는 마늘이 진짜 너무 맛있어요! 매울 줄 알았는데 하나도 안 맵고 감칠맛 찹찹 돌면서 진짜 맛도리예요!! 마늘+삼겹살 좋아하신다면 꼭 함 번 드셔보세요 저는 담에도 또 만들어서 흡입할 거예요!!🍀 ✅마늘삼겹찜 레시피 - 마늘 20개를 다져줍니다 너무 다지지 말고 조금 식감 있게 다져주세요 - 설탕 1T, 고춧가루 2T, 간장 2T, 맛술 1T, 굴소스 1T, 후추, 미원 조금 넣고 잘 섞어준 다음 - 팬에 삼겹살 600g을 구워줍니다 어느 정도 고기가 익었을 때 먹기 좋게 잘라준 다음 맛술 1T 넣고 한번 더 볶아줍니다 - 그리고 중 약불에서 물 200ml, 양념장 넣고 잘 섞어준 다음 물이 끓어오를 때쯤 다져준 마늘을 전부 넣고 섞어준 다음 자작할 때까지 졸여주면 끝! ✅ 계란찜 레시피 - 내열유리에 계란 2개 물 100ml 참치액 또는 소금 조금 넣고 간을 해주고 쪽파 올려 잘 섞어준 다음 - 전자레인지에 2분 30초 돌리면 끝 (제가 사용한 내열유리는 뚜껑 따로 안 덮어도 계란찜 잘 돼서 따로 안 닫고 돌려줬어요) . . . #집밥 #레시피 #food #asmr #mukbang

zh: 鸡肉咖喱面 用料：鸡腿10个、咖喱面酱150克、炒制用浓椰浆250克、浇头用浓椰浆250克、稀椰浆2升、鱼露30克、椰糖55克、粗盐10克、大号鸡蛋面饼10个、香菜、水 配菜：炸鸡蛋面、红葱丝、腌芥菜丝、辣油炒辣椒碎、柠檬角 做法：1. 锅中放约70克浓椰浆炒至出油，加入咖喱面酱翻炒，分次加入剩余浓椰浆炒至酱香浓郁。2. 放入鸡腿炒至鸡皮紧实，倒入稀椰浆搅匀，煮沸后加盐、鱼露、椰糖调味，再次沸腾后转小火炖至鸡肉软烂，淋入浇头用浓椰浆煮滚即可。3. 另起锅烧水，水沸后烫熟鸡蛋面，沥水捞出过凉水。4. 面条彻底沥干盛入碗中，放上鸡腿，舀入汤汁，摆上炸鸡蛋面、红葱丝、腌芥菜、辣椒碎和柠檬角，香菜点缀，吃前挤入柠檬汁。

d: เสน่ห์ของอาหารไทย กินยังไงก็ไม่เบื่อ . รสชาติของอาหารไทยที่เราคุ้นเคย อาจเป็นความสุขง่ายๆ ที่อยู่ใกล้ตัวกว่าที่คิด สำหรับ ‘เจมส์-ธีรดนย์ ศุภพันธุ์ภิญโญ’ นักแสดงผู้หลงรักการทำอาหารและเชฟแห่งร้าน Talayjai ความหลงใหลในรสจัดและรสแซ่บแบบไทย ๆ คือจุดเริ่มต้นที่ทำให้เขาอยากสำรวจเสน่ห์ของอาหารไทยให้มากขึ้น . จากไก่ทอดหาดใหญ่ริมทางหลังปาร์ตี้ สู่ความฝันที่อยากพาอาหารไทยไปอยู่ในพื้นที่ใหม่ ๆ อะไรคือเสน่ห์ที่ทำให้เขาหลงรักอาหารไทย จนกลายเป็นอีกหนึ่งแรงบันดาลใจสำคัญในชีวิต ชวนลิ้มรสเสน่ห์ของอาหารไทย และค้นหาแรงบันดาลใจที่อาจอยู่ใกล้ตัวกว่าที่คิด ใน Passion Calling x jamyjamess #TheStandardLife #TheUrbanGuidetoWellbeing #PassionCalling #PassionCallingwithjamyjamess #เจมมี่เจมส์ #jamyjamess #Seafood
zh: 泰餐的魅力，怎么吃都不腻。我们熟悉的泰国味道，或许就是近在咫尺的简单幸福。对于演员兼Talayjai餐厅主厨的James Teeradon来说，对泰式浓烈酸辣风味的热爱，是他想深入探索泰国菜魅力的起点。从派对后路边的合艾炸鸡，到梦想将泰国菜带入新领域，究竟是什么魅力让他沉醉其中，并成为人生重要灵感？一起品味泰国菜的魅力，寻找身边意想不到的灵感。Passion Calling x jamyjamess

d: เมนูสุดไวรัล กุ้งหนึบ ทำตามได้ง่าย ๆ ที่บ้าน ใครเห็นเมนูนี้ผ่านตาในโซเชียลบ่อย ๆ วันนี้ชวนเข้าครัวลองทำเองกัน เป็นเมนูที่ทำได้ไม่ยากใช้เวลารอสักหน่อยแต่รับรองว่าอร่อยฟินมาก วัตถุดิบ - กุ้งสดปอกเปลือก 300 กรัม - น้ำตาลทรายกับเกลือ 5:1 ใส่ตามปริมาณกุ้ง - น้ำมะนาว 3 ช้อนโต๊ะ - น้ำปลา 2 ช้อนโต๊ะ - น้ำตาลปี๊บ 1 ช้อนโต๊ะ - กระเทียม 5–6 กลีบ - พริกขี้หนูสวน. ตามชอบ - รากผักชี 1–2 ราก วิธีทำ 1. เตรียมกุ้งให้พร้อม ผ่าเอาเส้นกลางหลังออกล้างด้วยแป้งมันและโซดา พร้อมซับกุ้งให้แห้งที่สุด 2. นำกุ้งใส่ภาชนะแล้วเทน้ำตาลและเกลือ คลุกเคล้าจนเข้ากัน 3. ทิ้งไว้ในตู้เย็น 2-3 วัน 4. นำรากผักชี พริก น้ำปลา น้ำตาล กระเทียม ปั่นรวมกัน แล้วจึงบีบมะนาวลงไป จัดกุ้งใส่จานเสิร์ฟพร้อมน้ำจิ้มซีฟู้ดสุดแซ่บได้เลย ตัวกุ้งมีรสหวานเค็มอ่อน ๆ เนื้อหนึบให้ได้เคี้ยวกินกับน้ำจิ้มซีฟู้ดที่ทั้งเปรี้ยว เผ็ด รสชาติอร่อยจนอยากให้ลอง ใครเป็นสายกุ้งห้ามพลาดน้าา 🦐 #EatHere #อีทเข้าครัว #กุ้งหนึบ #เมนูไวรัล #เข้าครัวtiktok

d: #แจกสูตรกุ้งผัดพริกสด 🎉  แซ่บซี้ดสะใจ อร่อยสุดๆ ไปลงมือทำกันเลยจ้า  ***อัตราส่วนกุ้งผัดพริกสด*** น้ำมันพืช 2-3 ชต. กระเทียมจีนสับ 5 กลีบ พริกขี้หนูโขลกหยาบ 15 เม็ด เนื้อกุ้งหั่นชิ้น 200 กรัม ซอสหอย 2 ชต. ซีอิ๊วขาว 1 ชต. ผงปรุงรส 1 ชช. น้ำตาลทราย 1 ชช. น้ำเปล่า 2 ชต. พริกลูกโดด ตามชอบ วิธีทำ 1.ล้างกุ้ง ตัดหัวแกะเปลือกออกให้หมด ใช้ไม้จิ้มฟันจิ้มเอาเส้นดำออก แล้วหั่นเป็นท่อนเล็กๆ 2.ตั้งกระทะ ใส่น้ำมันลงไป เจียวพริกขี้หนูโขลกหยาบและกระเทียมสับให้เหลืองหอม ตามด้วยเครื่องปรุงทุกตัว รวมทั้งน้ำเปล่าลงไป เคี่ยวให้เดือดพล่าน จากนั้นก็ใส่กุ้งลงไปผัดให้เข้ากันดี พอกุ้งสุกก็ใส่พริกลูกโดด คลุกเคล้าให้เข้ากันก็ปิดแก๊ส จัดเสิร์ฟได้เลย #กุ้งผัดพริกสด #แม่ซีน้องมดดี้channel
h: แจกสูตรกุ้งผัดพริกสด, กุ้งผัดพริกสด, แม่ซีน้องมดดี้channel
zh: 爽辣过瘾，超级好吃，动手做起来吧，鲜辣椒炒虾比例：植物油2-3汤匙，蒜末5瓣，粗捣小米辣15颗，虾肉切块200克，蚝油2汤匙，生抽1汤匙，调味粉1茶匙，白砂糖1茶匙，水2汤匙，整颗辣椒适量，做法1.虾洗净去头剥壳，用牙签挑出虾线，切小块.2.起锅倒油，煸炒粗捣小米辣和蒜末至焦黄出香，加入所有调料及水，煮至沸腾，然后放入虾翻炒均匀，虾熟后放入整颗

d: 🇵🇭 Pork Adobo | Filipino Food Bible – Episode 1 My take on one of the most iconic Filipino dishes - Pork Adobo! This series will feature all filipino dishes in all their variations. consider this your guide to filipino cuisine. comment what you wanna see next! INGREDIENTS: Pork Adobo - 1.2 kg pork belly (or cut of choice) - 15–20 cloves garlic, minced (adjust to taste—more is always welcome) - 1 onion, chopped - 500 ml pork broth - 190 ml soy sauce - 100 ml cane vinegar - 3 long green chilies - 4 bay leaves - 1 tbsp whole peppercorns - 30 g palm sugar, chopped (adjust to sweetness) - Oil, for frying Toppings - Sliced onion leeks - Crispy garlic bits - Boiled eggs INSTRUCTIONS - Fry the pork until lightly browned on all sides, then remove and set aside. - In the same pot, sauté the garlic until lightly golden and fragrant. Add onions and cook until softened. - Return the pork to the pot, pour in the pork broth. Add the soy sauce, vinegar, green chilies, bay leaves, peppercorns, and palm sugar.  - Cover and let simmer on medium heat for 5-10 mins **don’t mix to allow vinegar to cook.  - Turn to low heat for 1–2 hours, until the pork is tender and the sauce has reduced. you want it to be almost swimming in its own fat like a confit - Optional: If serving with eggs, add the soft boiled eggs 2-3 mins before serving to retain jammyness - Serve over hot rice, topped with crispy garlic and leeks, and a hard-boiled egg on the side. Enjoy. #FilipinoFoodBible #filipinofood #asmr #cookingasmr #pinoyfood

d: 🇵🇭 Kare Kare | Filipino Food Bible Ep. 10 Kare-kare is a rich Filipino stew made with oxtail, tripe, and vegetables, all simmered in a thick peanut sauce. It’s usually served with bagoong (fermented shrimp paste) on the side to balance the flavors and an extra level of umami and saltiness 😋 INGREDIENTS: Boiling liquid: - 1-2 red onions, chopped - 2 bulbs of garlic, chopped - 1 tbsp of salt - 1 tbsp peppercorns - 5-6 bay leaves - 1 kg of oxtail - 650g of ox tripe - Beef stock as needed Kare Kare: - 10g of annatto powder - 2 tablespoons oil - 15-20 cloves garlic, minced - 2 tbsp annatto powder - 1 white onion, diced - 1 banana heart, chopped, washed and rinsed w/ salt - Beef stock as needed - green beans, chopped - eggplants, quartered - pechay/bok choy - 1 ½ cup peanut butter - Patis to taste - ½ teaspoon salt - 1 tbsp of sugar (optional to taste) Toasted rice slurry: - 1:5 tbsp of water to toasted rice, blended Served with:  - Bagoong  - Crushed peanuts INSTRUCTIONS:  - Start by seasoning your meat with salt and pepper and sear. Add all ingredients under “boiling liquid” and fill the pot as needed with beef stock. Simmer until tender, remove meat and set aside the broth for later.  - Saute onions, garlic, and banana hearts in oil mixed with annatto powder. Add your meat back and cover with the broth from the boiling liquid and simmer for 15-20 minutes. - To thicken the mixture, add toasted rice to a food processor or blender. Take some of the rice and mix with water to form our slurry.  - Add both rice slurry and peanut butter stir and reduce to thicken. Season with patis/salt/pepper and add your vegetables.  - Serve alongside bagoong top and enjoy!  #CookingASMR #ASMR #FilipinoFood #PinoyFood

d: My daughter had ONE request for her birthday lunch… Dad’s Chicken Adobo. ❤️🇵🇭 And what kind of father would I be if I told my little princess no? 😂 So Daddy got to work. Adobo-marinated grilled chicken thighs, potatoes, onions and hard-boiled eggs in that savory adobo broth, all served over rice with lumpia on the side. Packed everything up and brought it to her school so she could share one of her favorite meals with her classmates and teachers. As much as I love cooking for y’all and creating recipes, nothing beats cooking for my family, especially when my kids specifically asks for something Daddy makes. These are the moments that matter most. ❤️ Happy Birthday to my beautiful little princess. Daddy loves you more than you’ll ever know. And fellas… learn how to cook. Your kids might put you to work one day. 😂💪🏽 Marinade: • 1c cane vinegar or white • 1c soy sauce • 1 tbsp garlic powder  • 1 tbsp onion powder  • 1 tbsp coarse black pepper  Adobo: • 18-20 Boneless chicken thighs (whole Costco pack) • Dozen hard boiled eggs • 2c cane vinegar or white • 2c soy sauce  • 2c water • 1 whole white onion  • 6 russet potatoes • 10 cloves garlic  • 1 tbsp whole peppercorns • 2 tbsp white miso • 2 bay leaves Instructions: 1. Added chicken to my @DRIP EZ Prep Tub, added all marinade ingredients in, mixed and let marinate for 1hr.  2. Add all adobo ingredients into a large pot except chicken and eggs. Bring to a boil then simmer for 1hr until potatoes are fork tender.  3. Grill your chicken thighs until an internal temp of around 150F.  4. Place chicken and hard boiled eggs into broth then let simmer for 30-45min.  5. Once done let cool for 30mins then serve with rice, lumpia and garnish with crispy fried garlic.  Grill Island from @newageproducts.com  #chickenadobo #mealprep #schoollunch #filipinofood
zh: 我女儿生日午餐只提了一个要求……爸爸做的鸡肉阿斗波。如果拒绝我的小公主，我还算什么父亲呢？所以爸爸就动手了。用阿斗波腌料腌制的烤鸡腿，配上土豆、洋葱和水煮蛋，浸润在鲜美阿斗波汤汁里，全部浇在米饭上，旁边配着春卷。把所有东西打包好，带到她学校，让她和同学、老师们分享她最爱的美食之一。尽管我热爱为大家烹饪和创作食谱，但没有什么比为家人下厨更棒的了，尤其是当我的孩子们特地要求吃爸爸做的菜时。这些才是最珍贵的时刻。祝我美丽的小公主生日快乐。爸爸爱你，超出你的想象。兄弟们……学着做饭吧。说不定哪天你的孩子就会给你派活了。腌料：• 1杯甘蔗醋或白醋 • 1杯酱油 • 1汤匙蒜粉 • 1汤匙洋葱粉 • 1汤匙粗粒黑胡椒 阿斗波：• 18-20块去骨鸡腿肉 • 一打水煮蛋 • 2杯甘蔗醋或白醋 • 2杯酱油 • 2杯水 • 1个整白洋葱 • 6个褐土豆 • 10瓣大蒜 • 1汤匙整粒胡椒 • 2汤匙白味噌 • 2片月桂叶 步骤：1. 将鸡肉放入我的@DRIP EZ 备料盆，加入所有腌料，混合后腌制1小时。2. 除鸡肉和鸡蛋外，将所有阿斗波食材放入大锅。煮沸后慢炖1小时，直到土豆用叉子轻松穿透。3. 烤制鸡腿，直到内部温度达到约150华氏度。4. 将鸡肉和水煮蛋放入汤中，慢炖30-45分钟。5. 煮好后冷却30分钟，配上米饭和春卷，用酥脆的炸蒜装饰。Grill Island 来自@newageproducts.com

d: One of the biggest misconceptions about Filipino food is that it's all unhealthy. It's all brown, fried, fatty and salty. You know, the party foods? But it's far from the truth. There are plenty of "Lutong-bahay" or homestyle Filipino dishes that are nutrient-dense like "LASWA". It's an Ilongo vegetable soup dish that consists of a variety of exotic vegetables like eggplant, long beans or sitaw, kobucha squash or kalabasa, sponge gourd or patola, spinach, etc. Shrimp for protein is added and just salt for seasoning. Simple yet comforting and grabe, ang sarap! #filipino #filipinofood #filipinorecipe #foodtok #vegetables

🇵🇭 Arroz a la Cubana | Filipino Food Bible Episode 5 Arroz a la Cubana originated in Spain, making its way to the Philippines during the colonial period. Though it is a popular humble dish in its country of origins, there are elements that are distinctly Filipino in our version that set it apart. Namely, the use of saba, ground meat and other seasonings! 😍 INGREDIENTS: Arroz a la Cubana: - 1 whole white onion, diced - 10-15 cloves of garlic, sliced - 1 large tomato, diced - 2-3 tsp of tomato paste - 2kg of ground beef - 1/3 cup of soy sauce - 2 tbsp of Worcestershire sauce - 1 large potato, diced - 1 large carrot, diced - 1-2 bell peppers, diced - 1/2 cup of green peas - 1/2 cup of raisins - 1 tbsp of Spanish paprika - Salt and pepper to taste Others: - saba banana, sliced in half and fried - 2 eggs, sunny side up INSTRUCTIONS:  - To start sauté onions, garlic, and tomatoes until soft before adding tomato paste and mixing them together.  - Then add your ground meat, adding Worcestershire and soy sauce. Add vegetables like carrots, potatoes, bell peppers, and green peas along with raisins for added sweetness.  - Mix together, and season with paprika, salt, and pepper.  - Serve with saba, a heaping serving of your arroz a la Cubana, fried eggs and enjoy! #cookingasmr #asmr #filipinofood #pinoyfood

Episode 5: Homemade Garlic Longganisa 🇵🇭 (Pinoy-Style) Ingredients:  900 g ground pork 150 g pork fat (optional) 20 cloves garlic, finely minced 1/4 cup brown sugar 1 1/2 tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp white vinegar 1 tsp paprika 2 tbsp cornstarch 1 tbsp salt 1 tbsp black pepper Natural hog casing  Kitchen twine Procedure:  1. Rinse and soak the hog casing in water for 1 minute. Drain well. 2. Mix the ground pork, garlic, sugar, soy sauce, vinegar, salt, pepper, paprika, cornstarch, and cold water until sticky and well combined. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours 3. Stuff the mixture into the casing, being careful not to overfill. Twist and tie with kitchen twine. 4. Refrigerate for several hours or overnight to slightly dry the casing. Then freeze overnight. 4. To cook, place the longganisa in a pan with ¼ cup water. Cover and cook over medium heat until the water evaporates. Add 1–2 tbsp oil and fry until golden brown and cooked through, reaching 71°C / 160°F internally. You can add any seasoning but make sure you mix it well with the meat! Pwede adobo flavor or any. Enjoy my recipe and tag me pag nakagawa na kayo! ☺️ #ChefYlyt #privatechef #easyrecipes #homemade #longganisa

d: Filipino Barbecue!!🇵🇭🤙🏽 | Recipe’s Jordan Should Know Ep. 12 #cooking #recipe 🇵🇭 Filipino Pork BBQ Ingredients: • 2½ lbs pork shoulder, sliced ¼-inch thick against the grain • ⅔ cup banana ketchup • 1 cup Sprite or 7Up • ½ cup soy sauce • ½ cup calamansi juice • ⅓ cup brown sugar • 8 cloves garlic, minced • ¾ tsp black pepper Directions: 1. Mix the brown sugar, banana ketchup, garlic, soy sauce, calamansi juice, Sprite or 7Up, and black pepper. 2. Reserve 1 cup of the marinade for basting. 3. Add the pork and marinate for at least 4 hours, but overnight is even better. 4. Soak wooden skewers in water for about 30 minutes. 5. Fold the pork onto the skewers, keeping the pieces snug but not packed too tightly. 6. Simmer the reserved marinade for a few minutes until slightly reduced. 7. Grill over high heat, about 425–450°F. 8. Sear both sides, then turn every few minutes and brush with the reduced sauce. 9. Cook until the pork is nicely charred, sticky, and cooked through. Calamansi + Sprite or 7Up really gives Filipino BBQ that sweet, tangy flavor. 🇵🇭🔥
zh: 菲律宾烤肉！！| 乔丹应该知道的食谱第12集 菲律宾猪肉烧烤 食材： • 2.5磅猪肩肉，逆纹切1/4英寸厚片 • 2/3杯香蕉番茄酱 • 1杯雪碧或七喜 • 1/2杯酱油 • 1/2杯酸柑汁 • 1/3杯红糖 • 8瓣大蒜，切碎 • 3/4茶匙黑胡椒粉 步骤： 1. 混合红糖、香蕉番茄酱、大蒜、酱油、酸柑汁、雪碧或七喜和黑胡椒粉。 2. 留出1杯腌料用于涂抹。 3. 放入猪肉，腌制至少4小时，隔夜更佳。 4. 将竹签在水中浸泡约30分钟。 5. 将猪肉折叠穿在竹签上，保持肉块紧贴但不要挤得太紧。 6. 将预留的腌料小火煮几分钟至稍微收稠。 7. 在约425-450°F的高温下烧烤。 8. 两面煎封，然后每隔几分钟翻转，并刷上收稠的酱汁。 9. 烤至猪肉微焦、表面粘稠且完全熟透。 酸柑和雪碧或七喜真的赋予了菲律宾烤肉那种甜中带酸的独特风味。

d: Easy Pork Salpicao Recipe | Pinoy Style Ingredients: 	•	1 kg pork kasim (cut into strips) 	•	¼ cup soy sauce 	•	¼ cup oyster sauce 	•	1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 	•	½ tsp ground black pepper 	•	1 tsp smoked paprika 	•	Minced garlic (about 1 bulb or more) 	•	Garlic powder (optional) 	•	¼ cup butter 	•	2 bulbs garlic (for frying) 	•	2 cans whole mushrooms (halved) 	•	Coconut oil (for frying) 	•	Water as needed ⸻ Instructions: 	1.	Marinate: Combine pork, soy sauce, oyster sauce, Worcestershire sauce, pepper, smoked paprika, minced garlic, and garlic powder (optional). Marinate for at least 30 minutes or longer for better flavor. 	2.	Fry the Garlic: In a pan, heat oil and fry 2 bulbs of minced garlic until golden brown. Remove and set aside for topping. 	3.	Cook the Pork: In the same pan, add a bit of coconut oil and ¼ cup butter. Sauté the marinated pork until browned. Add a bit of water and simmer until tender. 	4.	Add Mushrooms: Stir in the halved mushrooms and the fried garlic. Simmer until the sauce reduces and oil starts to render. 	5.	Serve: Top with more fried garlic and serve hot with steamed rice #pork #recipe #salpicao #yummy #foodie
zh: 简易菲式蒜香猪肉食谱 食材： • 1公斤猪后腿肉（切条） • 1/4杯酱油 • 1/4杯蚝油 • 1汤匙辣酱油 • 1/2茶匙黑胡椒粉 • 1茶匙烟熏红椒粉 • 蒜末（约1整头或更多） • 蒜粉（可选） • 1/4杯黄油 • 2整头大蒜（用于油炸） • 2罐整蘑菇（对半切开） • 椰子油（用于油炸） • 水（视需要添加） 步骤： 1. 腌制：混合猪肉、酱油、蚝油、辣酱油、黑胡椒、烟熏红椒粉、蒜末和蒜粉（如用）。腌制至少30分钟，时间越长越入味。 2. 炸蒜：锅中热油，将2整头蒜的蒜末炸至金黄。捞出沥干，用作装饰。 3. 炒猪肉：在同一锅中，加少许椰子油和1/4杯黄油。将腌好的猪肉炒至变色。加少许水，炖煮至软烂。 4. 加入蘑菇：拌入对半切开的蘑菇和炸蒜。炖煮至汤汁收稠并开始出油。 5. 上桌：顶部撒上更多炸蒜，趁热配米饭食用。

d: Good things really do come in small packages. 🧚 Patupat starts with rice tucked inside intricately woven coconut leaves, but the real magic happens during cooking.  Sticky, chewy, and almost caramel like, this Northern Luzon delicacy is definitely worth the wait. Patupat marks the final episode of our 6 Days of Kakanin! Which Filipino food series should we explore next? Share your ideas in the comments. 👋  PATUPAT Ingredients: 2 cups glutinous rice, washed & soaked 4 ½ cups coconut water 450g panutsa, chopped coconut leaves (woven into small pouches) Procedure: 1. In a large pot, combine coconut water and panutsa. Simmer over medium heat until the panutsa is fully dissolved. Once dissolved, reduce to a gentle simmer. 2. Fill coconut leaf pouches about ⅔ full with raw glutinous rice. Seal tightly and securely.  3. Submerge the wrapped rice completely in the simmering syrup. Cook over low heat for 2 to 2.5 hours until rice is tender and compact and syrup has reduced and thickened. Rest for at least 30 mins before serving. Serving size: 6-8 pcs Preparation time: 20-30 mins Cooking time: 2.5-3hrs #featrmedia #kakanin #patupat
zh: 美好的事物确实会以小包装出现。竹叶糯米糕始于塞进编织精巧的椰叶中的大米，但真正的魔法发生在烹饪过程中。黏软耐嚼，近乎焦糖风味，这道北吕宋美味绝对值得等待。竹叶糯米糕是我们六天米糕系列的最后一集！接下来我们应该探索哪个菲律宾美食系列？在评论区分享你的想法。竹叶糯米糕 配料：2杯糯米，洗净浸泡、4杯半椰子水、450克椰糖块（切碎）、椰叶（编成小袋）。步骤：1. 在大锅中混合椰子水和椰糖块。中火慢煮至椰糖完全溶解。溶解后，转为小火慢炖。2. 将椰叶袋装入约⅔满的生糯米。紧紧封口。3. 将包好的米完全浸入微沸的糖浆中。小火煮2至2.5小时，直到米变软、紧实，糖浆变少并变稠。食用前至少静置30分钟。份量：6-8个 准备时间：20-30分钟 烹饪时间：2.5-3小时

d: This was a freaking 1000/10 🤤✨ Apple Pie Pull Apart Bread 🍎🥧🍂 Ingredients: Apple Filling: * 3 apples, peeled and diced * 2 tbsp butter * ⅓ cup brown sugar * 1 tsp cinnamon * ¼ tsp nutmeg * 1 tsp vanilla * 1 tbsp lemon juice * 1 tbsp cornstarch * 2 tbsp water * Pinch of salt Bread * 2 cans refrigerated biscuits * 1 stick butter, melted * 1 cup white sugar * 1 tbsp cinnamon Instructions: 1. Make the apple filling: Cook diced apples with butter, brown sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, lemon juice, and salt for 6–8 minutes. Mix cornstarch with water and stir it in. Cook 1–2 more minutes until thick. Stir in vanilla and let cool. 2. Make the cinnamon sugar: Mix the white sugar and cinnamon together. 3. Prepare the biscuits: Open each biscuit in half, creating two thinner pieces. 4. Build the layers: Dip each biscuit half in melted butter, then coat it in the cinnamon sugar. Place the pieces into a greased loaf pan, layering them with the apple filling between sections. 5. Bake: Bake at 350°F for 1 hour, or until the center is fully baked.       (The glaze on top is just 1 cup powdered sugar with 2-3 tbsp milk)    #easyrecipe #dessertrecipes #baking #fallrecipes #fallbaking
zh: 这个简直是一千分满分！苹果派手撕面包。食材：苹果馅料：3个苹果去皮切丁 2汤匙黄油 三分之一杯红糖 1茶匙肉桂粉 四分之一茶匙肉豆蔻粉 1茶匙香草精 1汤匙柠檬汁 1汤匙玉米淀粉 2汤匙水 少许盐 面包：2罐冷藏饼干面团 1条黄油融化 1杯白糖 1汤匙肉桂粉 步骤：1. 制作苹果馅：将苹果丁与黄油、红糖、肉桂、肉豆蔻、柠檬汁和盐煮6至8分钟。玉米淀粉加水调匀倒入，再煮1至2分钟至浓稠。拌入香草精放凉。2. 制作肉桂糖：将白糖和肉桂粉混合。3. 准备饼干面团：将每块饼干面团对半撕开。4. 叠层：将每片饼干浸入融化黄油，再裹上肉桂糖。放入抹了油的吐司模具，层与层之间铺上苹果馅。5. 烘烤：以350华氏度烤1小时，或直到中心熟透。（顶部的糖霜只需1杯糖粉加2至3汤匙牛奶调制）

d: Cookies & Cream Dipped Oreo Ice Cream! Full recipe 👇🏿#shorts #food #recipe  By Chef Kenny Ingredients Oreo Crust 40 Oreos, filling removed 6 tbsp melted butter Ice Cream Filling 4 cups heavy whipping cream 2 cans sweetened condensed milk (14 oz each) 15 chopped Oreos 3 tbsp cookies & cream spread Topping 20 Oreos, filling removed and chopped Chocolate Coating 12 oz white chocolate 2 Hershey's Cookies 'n' Creme bars Instructions 1. Remove the filling from the Oreos and chop them into crumbs. 2. Mix the Oreo crumbs with melted butter and press into the bottom of a lined 9x13 pan. 3. Whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form. 4. Add the condensed milk, chopped Oreos and cookies & cream spread. Gently fold everything together. 5. Pour the ice cream mixture over the Oreo crust and spread it evenly. 6. Add chopped Oreos over the top and lightly press them into the filling. 7. Cover and freeze overnight until completely solid. 8. Remove from the pan and cut into thick ice cream sandwiches. 9. Melt the white chocolate and Hershey's Cookies 'n' Creme bars together until smooth. 10. Dip the frozen sandwiches into the melted chocolate and drizzle some extra chocolate over the top. 11. Place back in the freezer for about 2 hours until everything sets. Enjoy!

d: Crispy Steak Mac & Cheese 🥩🧀 Ingredients 1 lb cavatappi 16 oz mozzarella 12 oz Colby Jack 8 oz sharp cheddar 4 oz Fontina 3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour 12 oz evaporated milk 2 cups heavy cream 1 tsp each garlic powder, onion powder & smoked paprika 1 tsp chicken bouillon ½ tbsp Dijon Reserved pasta water 1 large ribeye or NY strip Salt, pepper & garlic powder 1 tbsp oil + 1 tbsp butter Directions 1. Cook pasta 1 min shy of al dente; reserve 1 cup pasta water. 2. Melt 3 tbsp butter, whisk in flour and cook 2 min. Slowly whisk in evaporated milk, then cream, seasonings, bouillon & Dijon. Simmer 3–5 min. 3.Turn heat LOW. Melt in 4 oz each Fontina, mozzarella, Colby Jack & cheddar (16 oz total). Save the remaining 24 oz cheese for layering. 4. Add pasta. If too thick, loosen with reserved pasta water until very creamy. 5. Add half the mac to a baking dish → 8 oz reserved cheese → remaining mac → remaining 16 oz cheese. 6. Bake uncovered at 350°F for 25–30 min, then broil 1–3 min until golden and crispy. 7. Season steak and sear in oil about 3–4 min per side. Add butter and baste. For medium-rare, pull around 125–128°F and rest 8–10 min. 8. Rest mac 5–10 min, slice steak and pile it on top.  #macandcheese #comfortfood #easyrecipe #steak #cooking

d: SLOPPY JOE BUNS RECIPE BELOW Ingredients DOUGH 250 ml lukewarm milk (1 cup) 15 g honey (1 tbsp) 7 g instant yeast (1 tbsp) 1 large egg 45 g unsalted butter, room temperature (3 tbsp, 1/2 stick) 500 g all-purpose flour (4 cups) 8 g fine salt (1⅓ tsp) SLOPPY JOE FILLING 25 ml olive oil (2 tbsp) 600 g ground beef (1⅓ lb) 4 g fine salt (⅔ tsp) 3 g paprika (1 tsp) 2 g garlic powder (⅔ tsp) 3 g onion powder (1 tsp) 3 g cayenne pepper (1 tsp) 1.5 g black pepper (½ tsp) 100 g ketchup (6 tbsps) EXTRA cheese slices (American or cheddar) Big Mac-style burger sauce 1 egg, beaten Sesame seeds Instructions Prepare all the ingredients. In a large bowl, combine the lukewarm milk, honey and yeast. Stir well and let the mixture rest for 5 minutes. Add the egg and butter and mix well. Add the flour and salt. Knead the dough for 10-12 minutes until smooth. Cover the bowl and let the dough rise in a warm spot for 1 hour, or until doubled in size. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef, salt, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne pepper and black pepper. Cook for 7-8 minutes, until browned and cooked through. Add the ketchup. Stir the ketchup into the beef until well combined. Let the filling cool completely before adding it to the dough. Deflate the risen dough and divide it into 9 equal pieces. Shape each piece into a ball. Roll each dough ball into a round sheet. Place a slice of cheese in the center of each disc, then top with some of the beef filling and a spoonful of burger sauce. Add extra cheese if you like. Fold the dough inwards and pinch it tightly closed. Place the buns seam side down on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Brush with the beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Let rise for 30 minutes. Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C (400°F) for 12-18 minutes, or until golden brown. #food #sloppyjoe #beef #cheese #tiktokfood

d: Recipe👇🏽 Nashville Hot Mozzarella Sticks Just Got Crispier🌶️🔥 These mozzarella sticks just got a serious upgrade. Double-breaded, fried until golden and crispy, then tossed in a Nashville hot oil that brings the heat. Mozzarella Sticks 3 rectangles low-moisture mozzarella, sliced into ½–1 inch sticks Flour, for dusting 2 eggs, beaten 1½ cups breadcrumbs Oil, for frying Nashville Hot Oil ½ cup hot frying oil 2 tbsp cayenne 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tbsp brown sugar Slice the low-moisture mozzarella into ½–1 inch sticks and lightly dust them in flour. Freeze for 1 hour. Dip the frozen mozzarella into the egg, then breadcrumbs, then back into the egg and breadcrumbs again. Heat your oil to 350°F and fry the mozzarella straight from frozen for 2–3 minutes, until golden and crispy. You’ll know they’re ready when they float to the top and look nice and puffy. Don’t overcrowd the pan. While they’re frying, mix the Nashville hot oil ingredients together. As soon as the mozzarella sticks come out, brush or toss them in the hot oil while they’re still steaming. Serve immediately with ranch. I hope it crunches.

d: Recipe Name Cheesy Crunchy Beef Tacos Ingredients 1. 1 lb (450 g) ground beef 2. 8 hard taco shells 3. 1 tbsp olive oil 4. 1 small onion, diced 5. 2 garlic cloves, minced 6. 1 packet (1 oz) taco seasoning 7. 1/2 cup water 8. 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 9. 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese, shredded 10. 1/2 cup heavy cream 11. 2 oz cream cheese, softened 12. 1/2 tsp paprika 13. 1/2 tsp chili powder 14. 1/4 tsp black pepper 15. 1 diced tomato 16. 2 tbsp chopped fresh cilantro Recipe 1. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. 2. Add the onion and cook until softened, then stir in the garlic. 3. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles. 4. Drain excess grease and mix in the taco seasoning and water. 5. Simmer for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens. 6. In a small saucepan, melt the cream cheese with the heavy cream. 7. Stir in the cheddar, Monterey Jack, paprika, chili powder, and black pepper until smooth. 8. Fill each taco shell with the seasoned beef. 9. Spoon the warm cheese sauce over the beef. 10. Top with diced tomatoes and fresh cilantro. 11. Serve immediately while the shells stay crispy. Follow for more delicious recipes!

d: Hot Honey Chicken Tenders 🍯🔥  For all of you asking about the app I made (it’s free!!) you can search “osta” on the App Store or Google Play 😁 A little sweet, a little spicy and majorly crispy… served with buttermilk ranch.  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp cayenne pepper, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Hot Honey Sauce: -1/4 cup butter -2 to 3 tbsps hot sauce -1/3 cup honey For the Ranch:  -1/2 cup mayonnaise + 1/2 cup sour cream -1/2 cup cold buttermilk (use less for a thicker dip) -1 teaspoon red wine vinegar  -1 teaspoon dried parsley -1 tbsp fresh dill weed (or 1 tsp dried dill) -Spices: 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp fine sea salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper -1 tbsp fresh chives, optional Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick. Add to a mixing bowl with buttmilk, pickle juice, & chicken seasonings. Mix together. Cover & refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C. Keep the oil around this temp at all times.  4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture & stir to create flaky bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, coat each piece in the flour mixture. Shake off extra flour & place into the oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins. Fry for 7–8 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer to wire rack.  6. Meanwhile, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add honey and 2–3 tbsp hot sauce and whisk until smooth.  7. Mix the ranch ingredients in a bowl.  8. Toss or brush the tenders with the hot honey sauce. Serve with buttermilk ranch & enjoy! #cookingathometiktoktv #recipe #recipesoftiktok #easydinner

d: Keep the ship running and stay quiet Thalassomania is a PS1-style 4-player co-op psychological horror set on a derelict ship adrift in the open ocean. Stranded with your friends, you have to navigate, repair, scavenge, and steer the ship home, all while a relentless humanoid creature stalks you through every shadowy corner, sabotaging your work and adapting to your strategies. Split the duties, steering, engine maintenance, navigation, and resource management, communicate over voice chat, and stay silent and hidden when the creature comes hunting. Procedurally generated events, ship layouts, and creature behavior mean no two voyages play the same, all wrapped in chunky polygons, gritty textures, and moody retro lighting. Play with up to 4 players or face the horror alone. 🎮 Game: Thalassomania 🎯 Genre: PS1-Style Co-op Psychological Horror 👥 Players: Single-player, Online Co-op, LAN Co-op (up to 4 players) 💻 Platform: PC (Steam) 🛠️ Developer: OffTheHookGames 📅 Release Date: To be announced #indiegame #newgame #horrorgames #gameplay #steamgames

d: Crispy cheeseburger wraps Ingredients  For the beef mixture: 1 lb ground beef ( 80% lean, 20% fat ) 2 tbsp oil 1 yellow onion, finely diced  1 tbsp fresh garlic, minced 1 tbsp tomato paste Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  2 tsp smoked paprika powder  1 tsp onion powder  1 large jalapeño, chopped 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce  1/2 cup water For the cheese burger sauce: 1/2 cup mayonnaise 2 tbsp ketchup 1 tbsp yellow mustard 1/2 tsp Worcestershire sauce  1 1/2 tbsp finely minced dill pickles 1 tbsp pickle juice 1 tsp finely minced onion 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/4 tsp smoked paprika 1/2 tsp sugar 1/4 tsp black pepper To assemble: 9 medium tortilla wraps 1 1/2 cup Mexican style four cheese  1/2 cup caramelized onions 1/3 cup picked jalapeños, chopped  Oil for pan frying  Method: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion and cook 3–4 minutes until softened. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds. Add beef and cook, breaking it up, until browned and fully cooked. Drain excess fat if needed, leaving a little behind. Add tomato paste, salt, pepper, garlic powder, smoked paprika and onion powder. Cook 1–2 minutes. Add Worcestershire sauce jalapeños and water. Simmer uncovered 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the liquid has completely reduced and the beef is moist but not watery. Taste and adjust salt if needed. Remove from heat and cool slightly. For the sauce, mix mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, pickles, pickle juice, onion, garlic powder, smoked paprika, sugar and black pepper until smooth. Refrigerate until ready to use. Lay out the tortillas and spread about 1 tbsp sauce slightly below the center. Add about 1/4 cup beef, 2 tbsp cheese, caramelized onions and pickled jalapeños. Fold the bottom over the filling, fold in the sides and roll tightly. Heat a thin layer of oil in a skillet over medium heat. Place wraps seam-side down and cook 2–3 minutes per side, pressing gently, until golden and crispy. Continue cooking until all sides are crisp and the cheese is melted. Rest 1–2 minutes, slice in half and serve immediately with extra cheeseburger sauce.  #recipe #cheeseburger

d: Vodka Sauce Baked Ziti 🍂🍝 Classic baked ziti is one that doesn’t need much convincing, but vodka sauce takes it in a whole new direction. This version is creamy, a little spicy, and extra saucy, with plenty of ricotta tucked throughout and lots of mozzarella and Parmesan on top that gets bubbly and golden in the oven. I decided to keep it vegetarian, but I think spicy Italian sausage would take this one over the top. I also left the egg out of the ricotta so it stays a little softer and creamier, but you can absolutely add one if you prefer a firmer filling. I baked mine in my pumpkin pot for obvious reasons, but a 9-by-13-inch baking dish works just as well. Full recipe is linked in my bio!  #vodkapasta #bakedziti #ziti #fallrecipes #comfortfood

d: Steak Frites Sandwich with French Onion Soup Dipping Sauce 🥩🧅🧀 🇫🇷  P.S. Still crying from cutting an obscene amount of onions 😭 French Onion Soup Dip: • 2 tbsp oil • 3 tbsp salted butter • 4 white onions, sliced • 1 tbsp fresh thyme, chopped • 500ml beef stock • 1 cup Gruyère • 1 cup mozzarella • 1 whole garlic bulb • 2 bone marrow bones • Chives, to garnish Steak Au Poivre Grilled Cheese: • 2 fillet steaks • 1 tbsp fresh peppercorns, crushed • Salt • 1 tbsp butter • Garlic + thyme, for basting • 2 thick slices sourdough • Gruyère • 2 slices Gouda • Handful of mozzarella Frites: • 2 large potatoes • Vegetable oil, for frying • Salt • Chives Garlic Herb Butter: • Handful coriander, chopped • 1 tbsp butter • 1 garlic clove • 1 tsp salt Method     1    Lightly oil and season the bone marrow. Wrap the garlic bulb in foil and roast both at 200°C / 400°F for 30 mins until golden and soft.     2    Add oil and butter to a pan, followed by the sliced onions. Cook on medium-high for a few minutes until softened, then reduce to low and caramelise for 1–1½ hours until deep golden brown.     3    Add the roasted garlic and bone marrow, pour in the beef stock and simmer for 30–40 mins, reducing until rich and glossy.     4    Julienne the potatoes into thin fries and soak in cold water until the water runs clear. Dry thoroughly, then fry in vegetable oil until golden and crispy. Season with salt.     5    Transfer the onion soup to an oven-safe dish, top with Gruyère and mozzarella and bake until melted and bubbling. Finish with chives.     6    Crush the peppercorns and heavily season the steaks with pepper and salt.     7    Sear in a screaming-hot cast-iron pan for 2 mins, flip, then add butter, garlic and thyme. Baste for 30 secs and continue cooking until the centre reaches around 52°C. Rest for 4 mins before slicing.     8    Load the sourdough with Gruyère, Gouda and mozzarella. Butter the outside and fry until deeply golden and melted.     9    Microwave the garlic herb butter ingredients for around 15 secs, mix and brush over the toastie.     10    Add the sliced steak, crispy frites and chives. #french #frenchonionsoup #steak #comfort #recipe

d: POV: your dinner is watching you👁️👁️👻😂🤭 Save this recipe for Halloween🎃 Spooky Eyeball Stuffed Shells Ingredients: For the filling: • Vegan ground beef - 12 oz (340 g) • 1 Bell pepper, finely diced • 1 Onion, finely diced • 2 Garlic cloves, minced • Tomato paste - 1 tbsp • Tomato sauce - 1/3 cup (80 ml) • Smoked paprika - to taste • Italian seasoning - to taste • Olive oil - 1 tbsp • Salt and black pepper - to taste For the tomato sauce: • Strained tomatoes - 26.5 oz (750 g) • Agave syrup - 1 tsp • Italian seasoning - 1 tsp • 2 Garlic cloves, minced • Salt and black pepper - to taste For the stuffed shells: • 18 Jumbo pasta shells • 9 Mini vegan mozzarella balls, halved • Black olives - as needed, sliced • Tomato paste - as needed, for the veins • Fresh thyme - optional How to make: 1. Cook the vegan ground beef in olive oil over medium heat, breaking it into very small crumbles with a spatula. 2. Add the bell pepper, onion, and garlic and cook until softened. Season with smoked paprika, Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper. Stir in the tomato paste. 3. To make the sauce, combine the strained tomatoes, agave syrup, Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper. Simmer for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and cook for 1 more minute. 4. Stir 1/3 cup (80 ml) of the tomato sauce into the filling. 5. Cook the jumbo shells according to package directions until al dente. Drain and let cool just enough to handle. 6. Spread a layer of tomato sauce over the bottom of the baking dish. Stuff each shell generously with the filling and arrange in the dish. 7. Spoon a little tomato sauce over each shell. 8. Top each shell with half of a mini vegan mozzarella ball and a slice of black olive to create the pupil. Use a small amount of tomato paste to draw thin red veins over the mozzarella, then add a little fresh thyme if desired. 9. Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 15 minutes. Makes about 18 stuffed shells. #halloweenstuffedshells #eyeballstuffedshells #spookypasta #halloweenpasta #stuffedshells
zh: 第一视角：你的晚餐正盯着你看👁️👁️ 收藏这个食谱为万圣节做准备 恐怖眼球酿贝壳面 食材： 馅料： • 素食牛肉碎 - 12盎司（340克） • 1个甜椒，切细丁 • 1个洋葱，切细丁 • 2瓣大蒜，切碎 • 番茄膏 - 1汤匙 • 番茄酱 - 1/3杯（80毫升） • 烟熏辣椒粉 - 适量 • 意大利混合香料 - 适量 • 橄榄油 - 1汤匙 • 盐和黑胡椒 - 适量 番茄酱汁： • 过滤番茄 - 26.5盎司（750克） • 龙舌兰糖浆 - 1茶匙 • 意大利混合香料 - 1茶匙 • 2瓣大蒜，切碎 • 盐和黑胡椒 - 适量 酿贝壳面： • 18个大号贝壳意面 • 9个迷你素食马苏里拉球，对半切开 • 黑橄榄 - 适量，切片 • 番茄膏 - 适量，用于制作血丝 • 新鲜百里香 - 可选 制作方法： 1. 中火加热橄榄油，将素食牛肉碎炒散，用锅铲捣成非常细的碎末。 2. 加入甜椒、洋葱和大蒜，炒至变软。用烟熏辣椒粉、意大利混合香料、盐和黑胡椒调味。加入番茄膏翻炒均匀。 3. 制作酱汁时，将过滤番茄、龙舌兰糖浆、意大利混合香料、盐和黑胡椒混合。慢炖5分钟，然后加入大蒜再煮1分钟。 4. 将1/3杯（80毫升）的番茄酱汁拌入馅料中。 5. 根据包装说明将大号贝壳面煮至有嚼劲。沥干水分，稍微放凉至可以拿取。 6. 在烤盘底部铺一层番茄酱汁。将每个贝壳面填满馅料，摆放在烤盘中。 7. 在每个贝壳面上淋少许番茄酱汁。 8. 在每个贝壳面上放半个迷你素食马苏里拉球和一片黑橄榄做成瞳孔。用少量番茄膏在马苏里拉奶酪上画出细长的红色血丝，如果喜欢，可以点缀少许新鲜百里香。 9. 以350°F（180°C）烘烤15分钟。大约可做18个酿贝壳面。

d: Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv
